title: Prosaic
summary: PROSA'IC, adjective s as z. [Latin prosaicus, from prosa, prose.] Pertaining to prose; resembling prose; not restricted by numbers; applied to writings; as a prosaic composition.

inlines.v: PROSA'IC, adjective s as z. [Latin prosaicus, from prosa, prose.] Pertaining to prose; resembling prose; not restricted by numbers; applied to writings; as a prosaic composition.
